original: tasmāt iti karaṇapaddhatau aṣṭamo'dhyāya || atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ | kṛtāyaneṣṭarāśyante caraprāṇakalāntare | kuryāttadiṣṭarāśyantakālalagnamudāhṛtam || 1 ||
analyzed: tasmāt iti karaṇa paddhatau aṣṭama udhyāya atha navamaḥ udhyāyaḥ kṛta ayana iṣṭa rāśi ante cara prāṇa kalā antare kuryāt tad iṣṭa rāśi anta kāla lagnam udāhṛtam 1

original: iṣṭatatpūrvarāiyantakālalagnāntarāṃśakāḥ daśāhatā bhavantīṣṭarāśimānavināḍikāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: iṣṭa tad pūrva rāi yanta kāla lagna antara aṃśakāḥ daśa ahatāḥ bhavanti iṣṭa rāśi māna vināḍikāḥ

original: taṭajño guṇena prasanno nṛnamyo vareṇyo niviṣṭo vadānyo nṛpendraḥ | haridrā samudraḥ prahāro dināmbustavāṅgo nisargoṃ vilaṅgo viruddhaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: taṭa jñaḥ guṇena prasannaḥ nṛ namyaḥ vareṇyaḥ niviṣṭaḥ vadānyaḥ nṛpa indraḥ haridrā samudraḥ prahāraḥ dina ambu stava aṅgaḥ nisargaḥ om vilaṅgaḥ viruddhaḥ

original: vibhāvastṛṇaudho gajābho dhaneśo valeśo dhṛtāśaḥ kalātmā vipakṣaḥ | kṣamokṣo nilānto nirāsaḥ syurete kramādarddhitā vastrapūrvāḥ sphuṭāṃśāḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: vibhāvaḥ tṛṇaudhaḥ gajābhaḥ dhaneśaḥ valeśaḥ dhṛtāśaḥ kalātmā vipakṣaḥ kṣamokṣaḥ nilāntaḥ nirāsaḥ syuḥ ete kramāt arddhitāḥ vastra pūrvāḥ sphuṭa aṃśāḥ

original: karaṇapaddhatau namyaḥ priyo munirmānī nityaṃ pūjyastanurnnanu | sthāne jñānī priyo loke sūnuḥ prājñaḥ sthale punaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: karaṇa paddhatau namyaḥ priyaḥ muniḥ mānī nityam pūjyaḥ tanuḥ nanu sthāne jñānī priyaḥ loke sūnuḥ prājñaḥ sthale punar

original: lagne bhānurjanasthāne sūnurnāgastilaṃ nanu | vakrastatra nanu kṣepabhāgā dasrāditaḥ kramāt || 6 ||
analyzed: lagne bhānuḥ janasthāne sūnuḥ nāgaḥ tilam nanu vakraḥ tatra nanu kṣepa bhāgāḥ dasra āditaḥ kramāt

original: dasrāntakāryamabhagāditi vahni vāyuvasvekapādvihariśūrpagatāśca saumyāḥ | yāmyāḥ pare varuṇanaiṛtaśūrpabhānāṃ kṣepāstu divyanaganāgakalānvitāste || 7||
analyzed: dasra anta kāryam abhagāt iti vahni vāyu vasu ekapād vi hari śūrpa gatāḥ ca saumyāḥ yāmyāḥ pare varuṇa naiṛta śūrpa bhānām kṣepāḥ tu divya naga nāga kalā anvitāḥ te 7

original: nakṣatrāṇāṃ sphuṭāḥ kāryāḥ sakalāḥ saṃskṛtāyanāḥ | teṣāṃ krāntiguṇāḥ spaṣṭāḥ svasvavikṣepasaṃskṛtāḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: nakṣatrāṇām sphuṭāḥ kāryāḥ sakalāḥ saṃskṛta ayanāḥ teṣām krānti guṇāḥ spaṣṭāḥ sva sva vikṣepa saṃskṛtāḥ

original: paramāpakramakoṭyā vikṣepajyāṃ nihatya tatkoṭyā | iṣṭakrāntiṃ cobhe trijyāpte yogavirahayogye staḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: parama apakrama koṭyā vikṣepa jyām nihatya tad koṭyā iṣṭa krāntim ca ubhe trijyā āpte yoga viraha yogye staḥ

original: sadiśoḥ saṃyutiranayorviyutirvidiśorapakramaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | spaṣṭāpakramakoṭidyujyāvikṣepamaṇḍale vasatām || 10 ||
analyzed: sa diśoḥ saṃyutiḥ anayoḥ viyutiḥ vidiśoḥ apakramaḥ spaṣṭaḥ spaṣṭa apakrama koṭi dyujyā vikṣepa maṇḍale vasatām 10

original: sphuṭakrāntiguṇo bhūyaḥ kevalakṣepasaṃskṛtaḥ | parakrāntiśarābhyastaḥ parakrāntihṛto guṇaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: sphuṭa krānti guṇaḥ bhūyas kevala kṣepa saṃskṛtaḥ para krānti śara abhyastaḥ para krānti hṛtaḥ guṇaḥ

original: guṇahatāt tribhayuk sphuṭadorguṇād dinaguṇāpta dhanustribhayuksphuṭe | ṛṇadhanaṃ samabhinnadiśo bhavedivasamadhyagakālavilagnakam || 12 ||
analyzed: guṇa hatāt tribha yuj sphuṭa dos guṇāt dina guṇa āpta dhanuḥ tribha yuj sphuṭe ṛṇa dhanam sama bhinna diśaḥ bhavet divasa madhya ga kāla vilagnakam

original: yahā sphuṭe nijakalāsu bhidāṃ ca kṛtvā tasmin punastribhayute svabhujāpamajyām | navamo'dhyāyaḥ | kṣepāhatāmapamakoṭihṛtāṃ purovat kuryāt svamadhyadinakālavilagnasiddhyai || 13 ||
analyzed: sphuṭe nija kalāsu bhidām ca kṛtvā tasmin punar tri bha yute sva bhuja apama jyām navamaḥ udhyāyaḥ kṣepa āhatām apama koṭi hṛtām purovat kuryāt sva madhya dina kāla vilagna siddhyai

original: yadvā krāntitadīyakoṭyasukalābhedāṃstribhonasphuṭādānīyāsukalāntaraṃ tribhayute kuryāt sphuṭe tatra tu | tatkrāntyorvadhato'rdhavistṛtihatād yujyāvadhāptād dhanuḥ krāntyorbhinnasamāśayordhanamṛṇaṃ madhyāhnakālāptaye || 14 ||
analyzed: yat vā krānti tadīya koṭi asu kalā bhedān tribha ūna sphuṭāt ānīya asu kalā antaram tribha yute kuryāt sphuṭe tatra tu tad krāntyoḥ vadhatoḥ dhaviḥ tṛti hatāt yujyā vadha āptāt dhanuḥ krāntyoḥ bhinna sama āśayoḥ dhanam ṛṇam madhyāhna kāla āptaye

original: vikṣepakoṭīparamajīvāghātāt parakrāntito haraḥ syāt | kṣepāhate svasphuṭakoṭidojya hārāhūte koṭibhujāphale staḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: vikṣepa koṭī parama jīva āghātāt para krāntitaḥ haraḥ syāt kṣepa āhate hāra āhūte koṭi bhuja aphale staḥ

original: bhujāphalaṃ vyāsadale dhanarṇa vikṣepadorjyāharidaikyabhedāt | tadvargakoṭīphalavargayogānmūlaṃ bhavedāyanasaṃjñakarṇaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: bhujā phalam vyāsadale dhana ṛṇa vikṣepa dos jyā hari daikya bhedāt tad varga koṭī phala varga yogāt mūlam bhavet āyana saṃjña karṇaḥ

original: koṭīphalaṃ vyāsadalena hatvā karṇāmṛtaṃkūphalamāyanaṃ syāt | svarṇa sphuṭe tanmṛgakarkaṭāyoḥ kṣepe tu mepādigate'nyathā syāt || 17 ||
analyzed: koṭī phalam vyāsadalena hatvā syāt svarṇa sphuṭe tat mṛga karkaṭa āyoḥ kṣepe tu syāt

original: tasmin punaḥ prāṇakalāntaraṃ ca kuryāt tadā syānnatakāla papaḥ | natākhyakālastribhasaṃyuto'yaṃ mādhyāhikaṃ kālavilanakaṃ syāt || 18 ||
analyzed: tasmin punar prāṇa kalā antaram ca kuryāt tadā mādhyāhikam syāt

original: karaṇapaddhatī nakṣatramadhyāhajakālalagnāt svāsannarāśyantajakālalagnam | tyaktvāvaśeṣasya lavāḥ ghaḍāptāstandrāśiyātā ghaṭikā bhavanti || 19 ||
analyzed: karaṇa paddhatī nakṣatra madhya aha ja kāla lagnāt sva āsanna rāśi anta ja kāla lagnam tyaktvā avaśeṣasya lavāḥ ghaṣ āptāḥ tandrā āśi yātāḥ ghaṭikāḥ bhavanti

original: iti karaṇapaddhatī nayamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: iti karaṇapaddhatī nayamaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | bhānāṃ sphuṭāśca vikṣepā bahudhokkā budhaistataḥ | svacchāyāthaiḥ parīkṣyaite nirṇayā yantrasādhitaiḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: atha daśama udhyāyaḥ bhānām sphuṭāḥ ca vikṣepāḥ bahudhā ukkāḥ budhaiḥ tatas parīkṣya ete nirṇayāḥ yantra sādhitaiḥ

original: saumye śaṅkakṣaghāte tvamṛṇamiha diśābhābhujāṃ lambakanīṃ kṛtvāsmāt trijyayāptaṃ vidurapamaguṇastasya koṭirbujīvā | trijyābhākoṭighātād dinaguṇavihṛtaṃ cāpitaṃ kālalagne svarṇa pūrvāparāhe tribhavanarahitaṃ tadbhavedvāyukālaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: saumye tvam ṛṇam iha diśā ābhā bhujām lambakanīm kṛtvā asmāt trijyayā āptam viduḥ apama guṇaḥ tasya koṭiḥ bujīvā trijyā ābhā koṭi ghātāt dina guṇa vihṛtam cāpitam kāla lagne svarṇa pūrva apara ahe tri bhavana rahitam tat bhavet vāyukālaḥ

original: yadvā yāmyottarāpakramapalaguṇayoghatatastrijyayāptaṃ śaṅkī saṃskṛtya tasmāt triguṇakṛtihatāchambakakāntikoṭyoḥ | daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | ghātāptaṃ kālalagne kṣipatu kṛtadhanustyajyatāṃ prākkapāle kālo mādhyāhniko'yaṃ bhavati punarasau vāyukālastribhonaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: yat vā yāmya uttara apakrama pala guṇayoḥ oghatataḥ trijyayā āptam śaṅkī saṃskṛtya tasmāt daśamaḥ udhyāyaḥ ghāta āptam kāla lagne kṣipatu kṛta dhanuḥ tyajyatām prāk kapāle kālaḥ mādhyāhnikaḥ yam bhavati punar asau vāyukālaḥ tribha ūnaḥ 30

original: ghaṭikāmaṇḍale yatra spṛṣṭaṃ tannatamaṇḍalam | tatpradeśo vāyukālo natakālaḥ sa cocyate || 4 ||
analyzed: ghaṭikā maṇḍale yatra spṛṣṭam tat nata maṇḍalam tad pradeśaḥ vāyu kālaḥ nata kālaḥ sa ca ucyate 4

original: sarveṣāmapi sadhyā mahācchāyaiva doḥprabhā | kālalagnaṃ nirāścūnaṃ natakālastadā bhavet || 5 ||
analyzed: sarveṣām api sadhyā mahā chāyā eva dos prabhā kāla lagnam nirāścūnam nata kālaḥ tadā bhavet

original: natakālabhujākrānti vyastadikkaṃ prakalpya tām | sphuṭāpakramakoṭina sphuṭakrāntiguṇe punaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: nata kāla bhuja ākrānti vyasta dikkam prakalpya tām sphuṭa apakrama koṭina sphuṭa krānti guṇe punar

original: paramakrāntikoṭine kṛtvā tasmāt trijīvayā | labdho bhavati vikṣepastarakoṭiṃ ca samānayet || 7 ||
analyzed: parama krāntikoṭine kṛtvā tasmāt tri jīvayā labdhaḥ bhavati vikṣepaḥ tara koṭim ca samānayet

original: bhūyaḥ kṣepaguṇaṃ sphuṭāpamaguṇe kṛtvāmunā tāḍitā dorjyāsatribhavāyukālajanitā vikṣepakoṭyāhṛtā | antyakrāntiśarāhatā paramayā kāntyā hṛtā cāpitā svarṇa tulyabhidā śaghātavaśataḥ syādvāyukālasphuṭaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: bhūyas kṣepa guṇam sphuṭa apama guṇe kṛtvā amunā tāḍitā dos jyā sa tri bha vāyu kāla janitā vikṣepa koṭyā āhṛtā antya krānti śara āhatā paramayā kāntyā hṛtā cāpitā svarṇa tulya bhidā śa ghāta vaśataḥ syāt vāyu kāla sphuṭaḥ

original: yadvā svamadhyāhnagakālalabhe kṛtāsuliptāvivare svadorjyām | kṣepāntima krāntivadhena hatvā tarakoṭighātena vibhajya labdham || 9 ||
analyzed: yat vā sva madhyāhna ga kāla labhe kṛta asu liptā vivare sva dos jyām kṣepa antima krānti vadhena hatvā tara koṭi ghātena vibhajya labdham

original: cāpīkṛtaṃ ca svamṛṇaṃ prakuryāda vikṣepadorjyā haridaikya bhedāt |karaṇapaddhatau daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | tribhonite'smin punarāyanāṃśaṃ vyastaṃ ca kuryāt sa nijasphuṭaḥ syāt || 10 ||
analyzed: cāpīkṛtam ca svam ṛṇam prakuryāt vikṣepa dos jyā hari daikya bhedāt karaṇa paddhatau daśamaḥ udhyāyaḥ punar āyana aṃśam vyastam ca kuryāt sa nija sphuṭaḥ syāt

original: gaṇitamidamaśeṣaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ paṭhanto bhuvi gaṇakajanānāmagragaṇyā bhaveyuḥ | api ca gativiśeṣāt kālatulyasya viṣṇoḥ subhṛśamanubhavanto yānti taḍāma śuddham || 11||
analyzed: gaṇitam idam aśeṣam yukti yuktam paṭhantaḥ bhuvi gaṇaka janānām agragaṇyāḥ bhaveyuḥ api ca gati viśeṣāt kāla tulyasya viṣṇoḥ su bhṛśam anubhavantaḥ yānti taḍāma śuddham

original: ca iti śivapuranāmagrāmajaḥ ko'pi yajvā kimapi karaṇapaddhatyāhvayaṃ tantrarūpam | vyathita gaṇitametat samyagālokya santaḥ kathitamiha vidantaḥ santu santoṣavantaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: ca iti śivapura nāma grāma jaḥ kaḥ api yajvā kim api karaṇa paddhati āhvayam tantra rūpam vyathita gaṇitam etat samyak ālokya santaḥ kathitam iha vidantaḥ santu santoṣavantaḥ
